initial.name: athlete-directions
initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is the approved Cryptball art direction, NOT an edit target. Match its beautiful chunky 16-bit-plus pixel art, deliberate pixel clusters, warm ivory highlights, aubergine shadows, teal enamel armor, tan exposed arms, brown leather, cream helmet stripe and ram shoulder emblem. No text, labels, watermark, UI or decorative sheet border. These are asset source images for a game, not marketing layouts. Generate a transparent character turnaround sprite source sheet. Exactly eight separate full-body views of the SAME squat, broad-shouldered armored sport athlete holding a short wooden striking bat, identical costume and scale, generous clear padding. Layout 4 columns x2 rows, uniform cells. Row1 facing screen N (back), NE (back-right), E (right profile), SE (front-right). Row2 S (front), SW (front-left), W (left profile), NW (back-left). Camera fixed elevated front three-quarter, sees helmet tops; rotate CHARACTER only, not camera. Neutral athletic ready crouch each view. Preserve squat proportions of bottom athletes in reference, not skinny upright robot. Every figure fits its cell; consistent foot baseline within each row. No cast shadows or dust; genuine transparent background. Crisp contour, restrained highlights, no blur.

layers.name: court-floor
layers.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / game component. From this reference arena, create ONLY the complete playing-floor plane as a standalone transparent cutout. No walls, stands, statues, goal grilles, spectators, banners, torches or props. Preserve the reference's slate-purple paving pixel art, subdued pale sidelines, central skull roundel and goal arcs. Shape is a symmetric trapezoid, level horizontal far and near edges, far edge 75% width of near edge. Fixed elevated frontal camera, long goal-to-goal axis horizontal. The entire floor shape fits image with generous transparent padding, fully visible edges. No perspective diagonal rotation. Clean edge alpha, opaque floor. This is a source plate for calibrating a 2v2 game projection.
